sources.contains: Production crash groups for the last week: title, culprit, event and user counts, release, trend, one sample event with stack and user.
sources.use_when: Choosing which crash to fix, sizing a crash, or confirming the release that introduced it.
sources.access: Read the export at ops/crash-export.json (refreshed hourly from the crash reporter).

sources.contains: Support tickets for the last week: product area, plan, subject and customer message.
sources.use_when: Finding what customers report, how often, and their exact steps.

sources.contains: Weekly product analytics: active users by platform, iOS version share, checkout sessions, completions and revenue share.
sources.use_when: Sizing how many users or how much revenue a defect affects.
